caption:
✍️ Either/or: closest wins

✅ Rule: With either…or / neither…nor, the verb matches the closer subject.
❌ Neither the coach nor the players was ready.
✅ Neither the coach nor the players were ready.
✅ Quick check: Look at the subject right before the verb.
